description: Get a file sent with create_mailbox_batch, and each row's state now: queued, checking, connected, skipped or failed, with the reason. A file is kept 7 days. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.
name: get_mailbox_batch
title: Get a file of mailboxes
